Damien Madison now faces multiple felony charges, including first-degree assault, drive-by shooting, unlawful possession of a firearm, and felony alluding. He is also charged federally for fleeing across state lines after the pursuit. As a special agent from the FBI noted, this arrest serves as a notable illustration of how law enforcement partnerships lead to successful apprehensions of dangerous fugitives. His fiancé, Americus Wilson, was arrested at the scene and charged with rendering criminal assistance and obstructing law enforcement. At the time of publication, no sentencing has occurred, and all suspects are presumed innocent unless proven guilty in a court of law.
